preconditions: C0-A schema dependency admission is independently accepted.
The integration checkout has one writer and no production lane exists.
purpose: Establish immutable schema-only allocation, package and process-control baselines without implementing the ACP product runtime or UI projection.
probeOperations: deserialize accepted schema fixture only after bounded structural validation
reject every malformed and exact-plus-one schema vector without product persistence
launch the fixed local probe/control by exact absolute artifact identity in isolated evidence state
measure only the metrics assigned to C1 below without changing ceilings
exit with zero child processes and no retained listener or socket
commands: cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release --features acp-c1-characterization --bin acp_c1_probe --bin acp_c1_control
deliverables: probe and matched-control executable hashes and bytes
C1-assigned performance-budgets-v1 metric results and provenance

metricPartition.rule: C1 cannot claim, synthesize, or waive a C0-B metric; C0-B measures the exact integrated candidate against the same fixed C0-S ceiling.

retained: accepted Cargo dependency and lock identity
policy tests that exclude C1 artifacts from production

exitCondition: Independent Test accepts one exact C1 source/artifact/control identity; failure returns to Specify and never edits a C0-S ceiling.
